```python
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Inches, Pt, RGBColor
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from datetime import datetime

# Create a new document
doc = Document()

# Set professional styles
style = doc.styles['Normal']
font = style.font
font.name = 'Calibri'
font.size = Pt(11)

# ============ TITLE PAGE ============
title = doc.add_heading('Cloud Infrastructure Migration Proposal', 0)
title.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER

subtitle = doc.add_paragraph('Prepared for TechCorp Inc.')
subtitle.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
subtitle.runs[0].font.size = Pt(14)

date = doc.add_paragraph()
date.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
date.add_run('Date: ' + datetime.now().strftime('%B %d, %Y'))
date.add_run(' ').font.size = Pt(11)

# Add horizontal line
doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(240)
doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(240)

# ============ TABLE OF CONTENTS ============
doc.add_page_break()

doc.add_heading('Table of Contents', level=1)
doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(240)
doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(240)

# Create placeholder TOC (auto-generated by Word, but we'll add entries)
toc_items = [
    ('Executive Summary', 1),
    ('Technical Requirements', 2),
    ('Timeline', 2),
    ('Budget Overview', 2)
]

for title_text, level in toc_items:
    heading = doc.add_heading(title_text, level=level)
    heading.runs[0].font.size = Pt(11)
    heading.runs[0].font.bold = False

# ============ EXECUTIVE SUMMARY ============

doc.add_heading('Executive Summary', level=1)

This proposal outlines a comprehensive strategy for migrating TechCorp Inc.'s on-premises infrastructure to a cloud-based solution. The migration will leverage industry-leading cloud services to enhance scalability, reduce operational costs, and improve business continuity.

Key objectives include:
- Reducing IT infrastructure costs by 30%
- Improving system availability to 99.9%
- Enhancing disaster recovery capabilities
- Enabling scalable resource allocation

The proposed migration follows a phased approach to minimize disruption to business operations and ensure a smooth transition to the new cloud infrastructure.
"""
summary = doc.add_paragraph(summary_text)
summary.paragraph_format.line_spacing = 1.5

# ============ TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS ============
doc.add_page_break()

doc.add_heading('Technical Requirements', level=1)

requirements = doc.add_paragraph('The following technical requirements must be met for a successful cloud migration:')
requirements.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(12)

# Add bullet points
bullet_items = [
    'Compute and Storage: Cloud infrastructure with auto-scaling capabilities to handle variable workloads with minimum 99.9% availability SLA',
    'Network Security: Implementation of VPC, security groups, and encryption at rest and in transit (AES-256) to ensure data protection',
    'Backup and Disaster Recovery: Automated backup solutions with point-in-time recovery capabilities and cross-region replication for business continuity'
]

for item in bullet_items:
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style='List Bullet')
    p.add_run(item)

# ============ TIMELINE ============
doc.add_page_break()

doc.add_heading('Timeline', level=1)

# Create 3-column table with grid
table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=3)
table.style = 'Table Grid'
header_cells = table.rows[0].cells

# Headers
for i, header in enumerate(['Phase', 'Duration', 'Key Activities']):
    header_cells[i].paragraphs[0].add_run(header)
    header_cells[i].paragraphs[0].font.bold = True
    header_cells[i].paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(12)
    header_cells[i].width = Inches(2.5) if i == 0 else Inches(2)

# Rows
phases_data = [
    ('Planning', '4 Weeks', 'Requirements analysis, vendor selection, and detailed project planning'),
    ('Migration', '8 Weeks', 'Data migration, application integration, and staff training'),
    ('Testing', '4 Weeks', 'Performance testing, security audits, and user acceptance testing')
]

for phase, duration, activities in phases_data:
    row_cells = table.add_row().cells
    row_cells[0].text = phase
    row_cells[1].text = duration
    row_cells[2].text = activities

# ============ BUDGET OVERVIEW ============
doc.add_page_break()

doc.add_heading('Budget Overview', level=1)

# Create budget table
budget_table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=2)
budget_table.style = 'Table Grid'
header_cells = budget_table.rows[0].cells

header_cells[0].paragraphs[0].add_run('Cost Category')
header_cells[1].paragraphs[0].add_run('Estimated Cost ($)')
header_cells[0].paragraphs[0].font.bold = True
header_cells[1].paragraphs[0].font.bold = True

budget_items = [
    ['Infrastructure Setup', '50,000'],
    ['Data Migration Services', '25,000'],
    ['Professional Services', '75,000'],
    ['Training & Documentation', '15,000'],
    ['Contingency (15%)', '37,500']
]

total = 0
for category, cost in budget_items:
    row_cells = budget_table.add_row().cells
    row_cells[0].text = category
    row_cells[1].text = cost
    total += int(cost)

# Add total row
total_row = budget_table.add_row().cells
total_row[0].text = 'Total Estimated Budget'
total_row[1].text = str(total)
total_row[1].font.bold = True

# ============ FOOTER WITH PAGE NUMBERS ============
# Add a footer with page numbers
section = doc.sections[0]
footer = section.footer
footer_paragraph = footer.paragraphs[0]
footer_paragraph.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
footer_paragraph.add_run('Page ')
page_number = footer_paragraph.add_run(page=1)
page_number.font.size = Pt(9)

# ============ SAVE THE DOCUMENT ============
doc.save('/workspace/cloud_migration_proposal.docx')
print('Document created successfully: /workspace/cloud_migration_proposal.docx')
print(f'Created on: {datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")}')
```
